title: Non-determinism
content: Non-determinism is the tendency of an AI system to return different answers to the same prompt on separate runs.

meta.why: Because one answer is a single sample, a brand that appears in one run can be absent from the next.
meta.example: The same question asked five times names a brand in three answers and leaves the brand out of two.
meta.check: Run each tracked prompt several times, record each run, and report the share of runs in which your brand or page appears.
meta.limitation: More runs narrow the uncertainty without removing it, and results still differ by engine, location, and date.
